Subject: Webinar follow-up — Demo for BrightBank

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for registering for our 'Serving LLMs at Scale' webinar — really glad you could join (or at least registered). I saw BrightBank on the attendee list and wanted to reach out with a quick follow-up: we'd love to set up a short demo tailored to your team to show how Redwood can help reduce per-token costs and stabilize latency for customer-facing flows.

Quick things we typically cover in a 30-minute session:
- How we route across model/region tiers to meet SLA
- Batching/caching controls and expected unit-cost improvements
- A short live demo of the Console and Dedicated options

Do any of these times work for you next week?
- Tue Nov 30 — 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET
- Tue Nov 30 — 2:00pm PT / 5:00pm ET
- Wed Dec 1 — 9:00am PT / 12:00pm ET

If none of those work, feel free to pick a slot directly: https://cal.com/marissa-redwood/30

I’ve cc'd our solutions engineer, Vivek, who can join and tailor the technical bits.

Best,
Marissa Cole
